title: Peruvian cardinal hails $150m lead poisoning settlement for 1,300 people as a ‘historic milestone’

paragraphs.en: A Peruvian cardinal who received a barrage of death threats when he challenged the firm behind a toxic smelter has called a $150m (£111m) out-of-court settlement to more than 1,000 people who were allegedly poisoned by the plant as children “a historic milestone”.
paragraphs.zh: 一位因挑战一家有毒冶炼厂背后的企业而收到大量死亡威胁的秘鲁红衣主教，将一笔1.5亿美元（1.11亿英镑）的和解协议称为“历史性里程碑”。根据该协议，逾1000名据称童年时受这家工厂毒害的人将获得赔偿。

paragraphs.en: Cardinal Pedro Barreto, 82, was in Rome meeting Pope Leo XIV and other cardinals in June when he received news that the firm that ran the smelter, the Doe Run Company, a subsidiary of Renco Group, would pay $150m to 1,373 Peruvians who have suffered health impacts since childhood.
paragraphs.zh: 82岁的红衣主教佩德罗·巴雷托（Pedro Barreto）今年6月在罗马会见教皇利奥十四世和其他红衣主教时，得知运营该冶炼厂的杜朗公司（Doe Run Company，仁科集团Renco Group的子公司）将向1373名自幼年起健康便受到影响的秘鲁人支付1.5亿美元。

paragraphs.en: The news came as Barreto – the former archbishop of Huancayo, a city in the Peruvian Andes – was preparing to travel to the US to testify in the first of four civil trials in St Louis, Missouri, as part of a 19-year legal battle against Doe Run, which is owned by US billionaire Ira Rennert, who also serves as chair of the Renco Group.
paragraphs.zh: 这一消息传来时，巴雷托——秘鲁安第斯山脉城市万卡约的前任大主教——正准备前往美国作证，参加在密苏里州圣路易斯举行的四场民事审判中的第一场，这是针对杜朗公司长达19年的法律斗争的一部分。杜朗公司由美国亿万富翁伊拉·伦纳特（Ira Rennert）所有，他同时担任仁科集团董事长。

paragraphs.en: “This is a historic milestone,” said Barreto, speaking to the Guardian. “But this long-awaited justice doesn’t solve the problem faced by many children who were personally affected, especially neurologically. The money will not compensate for the harm they have suffered, but it is a sign that justice has been served.”
paragraphs.zh: “这是一个历史性里程碑，”巴雷托在接受《卫报》采访时说。“但这期待已久的正义并不能解决许多亲身受害儿童所面临的问题，尤其是神经系统方面的伤害。这笔钱无法弥补他们遭受的伤害，但它表明正义已得到伸张。”

paragraphs.en: Barreto led a nearly two-decade campaign to hold the US company to account for the severe health impacts on the population of the Andean town of La Oroya, which the Blacksmith Institute, a US-based environmental NGO now known as Pure Earth, in 2007 listed as one of the world’s 10 most polluted places .
paragraphs.zh: 巴雷托领导了一场历时近20年的运动，要求这家美国公司对安第斯小镇拉奥罗亚居民遭受的严重健康影响负责。位于安第斯山脉的拉奥罗亚曾被美国环保非政府组织布莱克史密斯研究所（现更名为Pure Earth）于2007年列为全球十大污染最严重的地方之一。

paragraphs.en: The settlement brought to a close one of the longest-running civil lawsuits against a multinational corporation in one country for environmental pollution or toxic exposure that caused injury or damage in another country.
paragraphs.zh: 这起和解结束了一场旷日持久的民事诉讼，涉及一家跨国公司在一个国家造成的环境污染或毒物暴露、导致另一个国家的人受伤或受损。

paragraphs.en: Schlichter Bogard, a St Louis-based law firm, alleged that Doe Run failed to reduce lead emissions at the Peruvian multi-metal smelter, resulting in permanent injuries and harm. Doe Run Resources Corporation, which has its headquarters in St Louis, did not admit wrongdoing in agreeing to the settlement.
paragraphs.zh: 总部位于圣路易斯的律师事务所Schlichter Bogard指控，杜朗公司未能减少其秘鲁多金属冶炼厂的铅排放，导致（当地居民）遭受永久性伤害和损害。总部位于圣路易斯的杜朗资源公司（Doe Run Resources Corporation）在同意和解时未承认有过错。

paragraphs.en: What began in 2007 in state court on behalf of 17 Peruvian children grew into a federal court case with more than 1,373 plaintiffs, now young adults . Each could receive at least $100,000 from the payout.
paragraphs.zh: 这起诉讼2007年始于州法院，起初是为17名秘鲁儿童提起，后来演变为联邦法院案件，原告超过1373人，如今他们已是年轻人。每人可从这笔赔偿中获得至少10万美元。
